Behind the Mask.name: Behind the Mask
Behind the Mask.description: The user reads a person or a room down to the faintest trace. Until the end of the scene, a disguised, transformed or impersonating person's own scent and pulse give them away even when face and voice match, and a concealed weapon or explosive, a drugged drink, a hidden compartment and a false wall all show themselves to the user. Strain: heavy.
